cover.coreProposition: Observability and normative judgment are not enforcement authority: a governable multi-agent institution needs an owned path from complaint intake through adjudication to scoped sanction or remediation, while rule-change authority remains separately controlled.
cover.visualMetaphor: Many small lights illuminate a visible breach, but the breach remains open until one bounded authority key engages a separate enforcement mechanism.
cover.semanticObject: A visible breach, many observer lights, one bounded adjudication key, and a separate rule-change module
cover.compositionIntent: Premium 16:9 editorial cover with deep indigo space, clustered cyan observer lights, one amber breach, a restrained violet authority key, glass-like depth, and no text
